G2_completeness.justification: All necessary bounds, operation constraints, existence guarantees, output requirements, and tie-breaking rules are provided.

G3_faithfulness.justification: Because each operation affects exactly two sequences, the resonance equation holds exactly when the three selected indices have all three pairwise conflict operations, so it asks for the same lexicographically smallest triangle as the original.

G4_naturalness.justification: The statement is coherent and readable, though the elaborate sequence-and-resonance reformulation is somewhat contrived compared with the original graph formulation.
